author: Andrew Van Til
releaseNotes: Uses the firmware's encDoorPosition for position instead of learning endpoints in the driver. Restructures the package into apps/ and drivers/ folders, simplifies the driver for Hubitat compatibility, and has the app push connection settings through a driver command.

apps.name: ratgdo32 Garage Door
apps.description: Guided setup that creates and configures a local ratgdo32 garage door device.
